messages:
fran: Heads-up — Veridian follow-up from the SSQ. They want concrete 'dataflow impact' evidence for KMS rotations and RBAC changes. Asked for: rotation logs (90d), canary/failover behaviour when key access is denied, and explicit service-account -> key mapping.

jordan: Got it. Do they want audited proofs (signed manifests) or just exported logs+replay steps?

fran: Prefer signed proof if possible but they said logs + a short runbook is ok for now. They keep pressing on 'what happens to in-flight inference requests during rotation'.

ravi: Short answer: we do envelope encryption; rotation creates a new wrapping key, old DEKs remain decryptable as long as they are stored. Need to show timeline + sample logs where rotation hit and inference succeeded.

kristin: I can pull rotation logs and the app traces. Two quick asks: which tenant id and do we need a canary test we can run live or is a recorded replay enough?

fran: tenant: tenant-07 (Veridian). A replay is fine but show a canary-run where we deliberately revoke key access and show automatic fallback to cached DEKs + graceful failure path.

sec-bot: Automated checklist: run `tools/gather-evidence --tenant tenant-07 --since 90d --include=kmsevents,audit,trace` and upload to /secure-share/veridian/2026-03-18. See playbook: https://redwood.internal/sec/evidence-playbook :eyes:

jordan: Example audit lines you can use in the bundle (obf keys OK):
```
{"ts":"2026-01-29T11:02:03Z","event":"kms.rotate","actor":"svc-kms-admin","key":"tenant-07-wrap-v2","result":"success","trace_id":"t-abc123"}
{"ts":"2026-01-29T11:02:05Z","event":"inference.request","actor":"svc-infer-ro","key_ref":"tenant-07-wrap-v2","result":"ok","latency_ms":42}
```

kristin: Perfect. I'll grab the logs and run a controlled canary tomorrow morning (non-prod routing) and capture traces. Any RBAC artifacts they want? service account list + last role change audit.

fran: Yes — provide a table (csv) mapping service-accounts -> key permissions and a filtered audit-export showing `role.grant` / `role.revoke` for the last 12 months for those service accounts. Also retention policy note (we keep kms-audit 1y hot, archive 3y).

ravi: SIEM query to extract KMS rotates and related inference traces: 
```
index=audit source=kms (event="kms.rotate" OR event="kms.fail") earliest=-90d | join trace_id [ search index=trace source=infer ] | table ts,event,actor,key,trace_id,result
```

kristin: Running that now. Will redact PII and generate signed manifest per playbook. ETA: uploading a preliminary bundle by EOD PST.

fran: Great. After upload I'll review and prepare a one-page note for the security call tomorrow (impact summary + screenshots of logs + remediation guidance). :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Note: if you need HSM attestation for the wrap key, open a ticket to infra with label `hsm-attestation` and include manifest id.

jordan: Small follow-up — we should include a short explanation of our prefix/KV cache behavior for in-flight requests so they understand why rotation doesn't drop everything. 2–3 bullets is fine.

fran: Agreed. Kristin, add a bullet about cache TTL, fallback to cached keys, and canary timeout behavior.

kristin: Will do. Uploading first zip to /secure-share/veridian/2026-03-18/prelim.zip in ~4h. Closing the loop here, ping me in thread if you need anything else.

fran: Thanks team.
